_comment: ratio_461_budget — ceiling on what production's 461-pair set may cost on untyped-endpoint anchored queries, relative to the 332-pair hand-list it replaced. #2801 measured 1.20-1.42x across three stable Windows runs (typed floor 1.05-1.12x); two additional runs were discarded as noise-dominated or as an anomalously fast 332-pair reference. The budget carries headroom for the stable range. Raise it only with a measured range, never a single run.
